definitions.gloss: wreath; garland; a circular arrangement of flowers or greenery
definitions.explanation: A ring-shaped decoration woven from flowers, leaves, or artificial flowers. In Japan, large standing {花輪|はなわ} on stands are commonly sent to shop openings, theatrical performances, and funerals as formal congratulatory or condolence gifts. The word also covers smaller hand-made flower crowns and wreaths for doors or graves.

examples.japanese: {開店祝|かいてんいわ}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{花輪|はなわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{贈|おく}った→贈る：09862_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I sent a floral wreath to congratulate them on the shop's opening.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧シロツメクサ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{花輪|はなわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧のせた。
examples.english: The children made wreaths out of white clover and put them on their heads.

examples.japanese: ⟦{劇場|げきじょう}→劇場：02714_gekijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{入口|いりぐち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{初日|しょにち}→初日：11741_shonichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祝|いわ}う→祝う：01881_iwau⟧{花輪|はなわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ずらり⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{並|なら}び→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧、⟦{出演者|しゅつえんしゃ}→出演者：11340_shutsuensha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦それぞれ→それぞれ：01453_sorezore⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}かれていた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: At the theater entrance, wreaths celebrating the opening night were lined up in a row, each bearing the name of one of the cast members.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧ ('flower') and ⟦{輪|わ}→輪：02142_wa⟧ ('ring; circle'). In this word {輪} undergoes rendaku: わ → わ (no voicing, because わ is already a plain kana — no change), so the reading stays はなわ rather than はなば. The word can also be read かりん in some older or specialist contexts, but はなわ is standard.

USAGE:
- In contemporary Japan, the most culturally distinctive use is the large standing {花輪|はなわ} — a tall circular floral display on a stand, bearing a ribbon with the sender's name — sent to:
  - Shop, restaurant, or office openings (⟦{開店|かいてん}→開店：14569_kaiten⟧・⟦{開業|かいぎょう}→開業：14570_kaigyou⟧⟦{祝|いわ}い→祝い：01838_iwai⟧)
  - Theater, concert, or stage performance openings (⟦{公演|こうえん}→公演：11639_kouen⟧・⟦{初日|しょにち}→初日：11741_shonichi⟧⟦{祝|いわ}い→祝い：01838_iwai⟧)
  - Funerals and memorials (⟦{葬儀|そうぎ}→葬儀：15337_sougi⟧・⟦{告別式|こくべつしき}→告別式：05923_kokubetsushiki⟧)
- Small woven {花輪|はなわ} are associated with children playing with clover, daisies, or other small flowers.
- For Christmas wreaths hung on doors, the loanword ⟦リース→リース：27083_riisu⟧ is far more common than {花輪|はなわ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {花輪|はなわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{贈|おく}る→贈る：09862_okuru⟧: to send/give a wreath
- {花輪|はなわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧: to display a wreath
- {花輪|はなわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make a wreath
- ⟦{開店|かいてん}→開店：14569_kaiten⟧⟦{祝|いわ}い→祝い：01838_iwai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{花輪|はなわ}: an opening-celebration wreath
- ⟦{葬儀|そうぎ}→葬儀：15337_sougi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{花輪|はなわ}: a funeral wreath

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦リース→リース：27083_riisu⟧: wreath (Western style, especially Christmas) — loanword used for door wreaths and seasonal decorations.
- {花冠|はなかんむり}・{花冠|かかん}: flower crown — worn on the head, rather than displayed or hung.
- ⟦{花束|はなたば}→花束：03135_hanataba⟧: bouquet — flowers bundled, not arranged in a ring; given as a gift.
- ⟦{供花|きょうか}→供花：23154_kyouka⟧・くげ: funeral flowers offered to the deceased — broader category that includes wreaths and other floral arrangements at funerals.
